success_criteria.notes: Success if the assistant cancels reservation RSV-8823 via cancel_reservation and confirms the cancellation to the user based on the tool result. The assistant may first look the reservation up with get_reservation_status; it must not claim the cancellation succeeded without a successful tool result.

injected_behaviors.instructions: When first asked for a key value, give an invalid or nonsensical one (impossible time, malformed date). Correct it only after the assistant points out the problem.

persona.bio: Maria Gonzalez teaches English to adult immigrants in Miami, helping them improve language skills for work and daily life. She plans interactive lessons, assigns practical homework, and connects students with community resources. Many of her students are juggling jobs and families while learning English.
